headerEntries: Aza casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aza makes two Beguiling Resonance attacks.

action.name: Beguiling Resonance
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Enchanting Presence
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of Aza must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition charmed} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any muse's Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.
Whenever Aza deals damage to the {@condition charmed} creature, the {@condition charmed} creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: The whirlwyrm makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. headerEntries: Shariel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). Shariel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: Shariel's weapon attacks are magical. When Shariel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Shariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Shariel makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: Shariel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Shariel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Shariel's choice).

In a new form, Shariel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

entries: The impersonator can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Read Thoughts
entries: The impersonator magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the impersonator can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the impersonator's {@status concentration} isn't broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the impersonator has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) and Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, and {@skill Persuasion}) checks against the target.
